final_assessment: All 9 findings resolved, 0 stale, 0 deferred — 5 through the obvious-fix lane and 4 through the decision lane, every one ratified by chat directive. The walk's character: every finding was wake from the 03:02 reversal, which had landed perfectly in the delta and raggedly in the prose explaining it, so the work was making four artifacts tell one story. NOTHING NORMATIVE MOVED — the three delta specs are byte-identical to their pre-walk state, fingerprints 5/5, validate --strict clean, 2238/2238 green — and that was a decision, not an accident: finding #9's option B would have edited a converged requirement for four words and was declined in favour of fixing the description that misdescribed it. Two self-caught defects are worth the record. Finding #1's correction note first landed as a 5th cell against a 4-column header, reproducing finding #8's exact defect one table over, caught by running #8's own cell count on the table I had just edited. Finding #6's cascade surfaced a fourth residue site the finding had missed (explore.md:50), handled by appending a dated CORRECTED block rather than rewriting the decision text. The heaviest single resolution was #1 option C: D-rc04d-2 is cited by name three times as the stage's authority, and a source-of-truth correct in its table and wrong in its prose is worse than one uniformly stale, because the table's correctness is what persuades a reader to trust the paragraph. Finding #7 is the one that leaves a residual: exit (2)'s instrument is now path-scoped and honest about the R-crc-12 boundary, but the scoped check still reports test/core/sources-registry.test.ts while the R-crc-13 ruling bump sits uncommitted in the shared tree. AT-ARCHIVE NOTE (c) now specifies the readiness-record entry; landing that bump in its own architect commit would make the check read clean, and that is a commit-boundary call for the user.
